subject: New complaint submitted via website - discolored tablets
bodyText:
A new product quality complaint has been submitted through the consumer website.

Summary: Consumer reports that approximately one third of the tablets in a newly
purchased bottle of Nortavex (Lot LOT-7734B) were discolored with dark grey speckling
compared to the expected off-white color. No tablets were taken and no harm was reported.

The full intake form is attached as a PDF for your records.

This is an automated notification from the Consumer Affairs Portal.

The quantity affected is specified as one bottle containing 30 tablets. The specific complaint details state that approximately one third of the tablets in the bottle showed visible discoloration with dark grey speckling. The remaining tablets matched the expected off-white color. The consumer noticed this issue upon opening a newly purchased bottle on 17-Aug-2026. No photo was included with the submission, and no patient harm was reported because the tablets were not taken. The submitter information indicates the complaint came from an anonymous consumer via the company website complaint form.
